name: unresolved-attribution
description: setns(2) with enrichment.container_id explicitly null (CRI enrichment layer has not yet resolved the container identity). Per the design principle 'unresolved attribution never alerts', the predicate evaluator treats null enrichment.container_id as non-match (false), so no container-escape rule fires even though the syscall is suspicious. Identity fields are present (kernel-observable) but the CRI resolution is pending. Expect no match.
